_outletNote: Okkiyam Madavu outlet channel to Buckingham Canal at lat 12.9232, lon 80.2430 (rows 246-247, cols 190-191).

_notes.roadBurnM: Metres the terrain is lowered along every OSM road cell so rain runs down streets and collects in street dips that a 30 m surface DEM (rooftops, trees) hides. 1.0 m is an ASSUMPTION (typical 'stream-burn' depth for conditioning a DEM); 0 turns it off. It was NOT fitted to the validation data, but values 0.5/1/2 were all looked at when it was introduced, see docs/scores.md.
